chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl, from Abī al-Ṣabbāḥ al-Kinānī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
If the woman becomes pure before the rising of dawn, she performs the maghrib and the ʿishāʾ prayers; and if she becomes pure before the sun sets, she performs the ẓuhr and the ʿaṣr prayers.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman subject to this legal ruling
key_terms.طَهُرَتِ: became pure from menstrual or similar bleeding
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ: the rise of dawn marking the end of the night prayer period

ai.seo_question: What prayers must a woman perform if she becomes pure from menstruation before dawn or before sunset?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman who regains ritual purity before the end of a prayer period. It states that if her purity returns before dawn, she performs maghrib and ʿishāʾ, and if it returns before sunset, she performs ẓuhr and ʿaṣr.
